title: calawaya caulina
intro: Calawaya caulina, commonly known as the 'Calawaya' or 'Maca', is a type of Peruvian plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. The plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including the ability to improve fertility, reduce stress and anxiety, and boost energy levels. The therapeutic actions of Maca include its adaptogenic properties, which help to balance the body's hormonal levels and regulate its response to stress. The bioactive constituents of Calawaya caulina include glucosinolates, alkaloids, and sterols, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
